scope: The 28 original open PRs in the user goal; candidate SVG phase fix and new font checks are not yet a merged result.
notACompletionAttestation: This is an evidence index. Passing counts and remaining product/fixture conditions must be read from each linked source. It is not a claim that all historical PRs or their whole applications are fixed.
